note: Files the floor's own rows edit by path (floor/rows/*.mjs). A whole-chain replay re-runs those rows, and a row reads its applied state at the path it names, so a route that moves one of these files, or rewrites a span a row wrote, breaks the replay (rows/lib.mjs: 'does not exist'). B never moves them; a module whose law needs one moved is declined and reported (LAW §7).
